_about: Icon manifest for bin/bookmarklet-favicon. Keys are bookmark names; emoji and symbols in a name are ignored when matching, so 'Wayback' also matches '🕰️ Wayback'. Values are specs: emoji:X, symbol:material_name, text:AB, file:/path.svg, like:https://site/, url:https://site/. Options after a comma: bg=#hex, fg=#hex, fill=0|1, wght=100..700.
